verdict.rationale: The docs show LibreChat lets self-hosters bring their own providers and keys. You configure custom OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints such as OpenRouter and Ollama in librechat.yaml, and a community comment describes paying for API usage directly instead of a ChatGPT subscription. Nothing in the evidence shows token usage or cost tracking, so only the bring-your-own-backend half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: any documented token usage display, any per-model or per-conversation cost reporting, and explicit documentation of user-provided API keys or subscription logins.
